# City Electric Supply Blog

> > The official blog of City Electric Supply (CES), a top-seven electrical wholesale distributor in the U.S., featuring company news, branch expansions, community initiatives, and industry insights.

City Electric Supply's blog chronicles the company's growth across Texas, Florida, South Carolina, Wisconsin, Puerto Rico, and beyond, while highlighting leadership achievements like Thomas Hartland-Mackie's EY Entrepreneur of the Year Award, partnerships with organizations like Wounded Warrior Project and Milwaukee Tool, and community impact through CES Cares initiatives. The blog serves as a newsroom for electrical contractors, industry professionals, and stakeholders interested in electrical wholesale distribution and sustainable building practices.

## Key Topics

- City Electric Supply (CES)
- Electrical wholesale distribution
- Branch openings and expansion
- Thomas Hartland-Mackie (CEO)
- Texas market presence
- Florida operations
- South Carolina growth
- Community giving and CES Cares
- Wounded Warrior Project partnership
- Milwaukee Tool collaboration
- TAMCO Group manufacturing
- CES Marine Solutions
- Sustainable building practices
- NAED membership
- Puerto Rico expansion

- [Seventh-Largest Electrical Wholesale Distributor in the U.S. Hosted its Biggest Conference After Four-Year Hiatus](https://blog.cityelectricsupply.com/seventh-largest-electrical-wholesale-distributor-in-the-u-s-hosted-its-biggest-conference-after-four-year-hiatus-3): CES Connect 2022 conference returns to Orlando after four-year hiatus

## Branch Openings & Expansion

- [City Electric Supply Hutto Opens as Company's 39th Texas Branch](https://blog.cityelectricsupply.com/city-electric-supply-hutto-opens-as-companys-39th-texas-branch): CES Hutto opens as 39th Texas branch milestone on Priem Lane
- [City Electric Supply Opens Second Location on Island of Puerto Rico](https://blog.cityelectricsupply.com/city-electric-supply-opens-second-location-on-island-of-puerto-rico-6): CES announces second Puerto Rico branch opening in Arecibo
- [City Electric Supply Opens New South Carolina Branch](https://blog.cityelectricsupply.com/city-electric-supply-opens-new-south-carolina-branch): CES expands to North Charleston with Patrick Rourk as branch manager

- [City Electric Supply Celebrates Another Florida Branch Opening](https://blog.cityelectricsupply.com/city-electric-supply-celebrates-another-florida-branch-opening): CES opens new Apopka, Florida branch with Ed Ustanik as manager
- [City Electric Supply Opens Fourth Store in Orlando](https://blog.cityelectricsupply.com/city-electric-supply-opens-fourth-store-in-orlando): CES Orlando Central becomes fourth branch in Orlando market
- [TAMCO Opens 441,000 Sq Ft Manufacturing & Fulfillment Center in Florida](https://blog.cityelectricsupply.com/tamco-opens-441000-sq-ft-manufacturing-fulfillment-center-in-florida): TAMCO Group opens 441K sq ft facility in Port St. Lucie, Florida
